page.title: Channels
page.subtitle: Where customers talk to your assistants

telegram.title: Connect a Telegram bot
telegram.description: Create a bot in @BotFather and paste its token. We host it and route its messages.

api.title: Create an API channel
api.description: Send messages and events from your website, app or CRM with a secret key.

create.title: New API channel
create.description: You get an endpoint and a secret key
create.name: Name
create.webhookHint: Operator replies, follow-ups and event messages. You can add it later.

secret.title: Your secret key
secret.copyWarning: Copy it now — we only show a key once. If you lose it, rotate it.
secret.rotationHint: After a rotation the previous key keeps working for 24 h.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.secretHint: Send it as a Bearer token. We show a key only once; rotating gives you 24 h to switch.

whoAnswers.title: Who answers and how replies come back
whoAnswers.replyHint: In the response: the call waits for the flow (up to 30 s) and returns its messages.
whoAnswers.webhookHint: Operator replies, scheduled follow-ups and event messages arrive here. Required when a person can take over.

example.title: Example request
example.hint: Use the same user_id to continue a conversation. When status is “escalated”, the operator’s replies come later to your webhook.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the {{name}} API channel?
deleteDialog.body: Requests with its key start failing with 401 right away, so {{agent}} stops answering here. Past conversations stay in the Inbox and Langfuse.

telegram.title: Connect a Telegram bot
telegram.subtitle: We set the webhook and receive messages for you
telegram.loadError: The bot could not be loaded.

form.tokenError: Telegram didn’t accept this token. It looks like 123456789:AA… — copy it again.
form.agentRequired: Choose the agent that answers this bot.
form.agentHint: You can change the agent later.

howTo.title: How to connect a bot
howTo.stepName: Pick a name and a username ending in “bot”
howTo.stepCopy: Copy the token and paste it here

bot.subtitle: Telegram bot · answered by {{agent}}

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {{username}}?
disconnectDialog.body: We remove our webhook and stop receiving this bot’s messages.
disconnectDialog.bodyWithApi: We remove our webhook and stop receiving this bot’s messages. {{agent}} keeps answering through API · {{channel}}.
disconnectDialog.warning: Open Telegram chats stay readable in the Inbox, but nobody can reply to them until a bot is connected again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{username}}?
deleteDialog.description: Telegram bot · this can’t be undone
deleteDialog.body: We remove the webhook and delete this channel. Past conversations stay in the Inbox and Langfuse.

replaceDialog.title: Replace the token for {{username}}?
replaceDialog.description: Telegram bot · the webhook is registered again with the new token
replaceDialog.tokenHint: In @BotFather, send /token, pick this bot and copy the new token.
replaceDialog.tokenError: Telegram didn’t accept this token. It looks like 123456789:AA… — copy it again.

connection.title: Connection
connection.disconnectedHint: This bot is disconnected. Connect it again to receive new messages.
connection.tokenHint: From @BotFather. We register the webhook and receive this bot’s messages for you.
connection.revokedNote: Telegram rejected this token on {{date}} at {{time}} — it was revoked or regenerated in @BotFather.

whoAnswers.title: Who answers
whoAnswers.publishedHint: Always runs the published version (v{{version}} now).
whoAnswers.draftHint: Draft — publish it to start answering.

fix.title: How to fix it
fix.stepPick: Pick {{username}} and copy the new token
fix.stepPaste: Paste it here and press Replace token

bot.warning: Messages sent to the bot while the token was revoked can’t be recovered — Telegram didn’t deliver them to us.
